name: Phasmophilia
source:
It's going to be a typical evening on the job. Driving, investigating, dying. Nothing special whatsoever about the 14th of February.

Or is there?

Tonight, at the warehouse, you find lonely souls other than yourself searching for love, mystery-date style. You've tried everything else--dating apps, meetups, blind dates, speed dates, bribery--why not give this a go?

Or are you too scared?

[From [url=https://r-m-g.itch.io/phasmophilia]Itch.io[/url]]
